WITH budget_stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(amount) as overall_avg
  FROM budget
  WHERE amount IS NOT NULL
),
event_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    link_to_event,
    AVG(amount) as event_avg
  FROM budget
  WHERE amount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY link_to_event
),
filtered_events AS (
  SELECT 
    ea.link_to_event,
    ea.event_avg,
    bs.overall_avg
  FROM event_averages ea
  CROSS JOIN budget_stats bs
  WHERE ea.event_avg > bs.overall_avg
),
kept_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(event_avg) as kept_events_avg
  FROM filtered_events
)
SELECT 
  fe.link_to_event,
  fe.event_avg,
  (fe.event_avg - fe.overall_avg) as above_overall_average,
  (fe.event_avg - ka.kept_events_avg) as difference_from_kept_average
FROM filtered_events fe
CROSS JOIN kept_average ka
ORDER BY difference_from_kept_average DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Ignoring missing amounts means excluding rows where budget.amount is NULL from all average calculations
